course.title: Rural Development Planning-I
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value:
Write short notes from the following (any five): (5x7=3!   
i. Incidence of poverty and poverty line expenditure   
ii. Poverty line calorie intake and prevalence of malnutrition   
iii. Poverty gap and poverty trap   
iv. Price policy   
V. Swanirvar (Self-reliance) Movement   
vi. Recent interventions of the Government for agricultural   
development of Bangladesh.   
vii. Rural development initiatives by local NGOs.
